localizedValues.name: S1
localizedValues.description:
Rockport’s picnic shelter is located in the Day-Use Area underneath towering trees and a close distance to the parking lot. It includes 4 picnic tables, a campfire pit with fire ring and grill, and log amphitheater seating. All park trailheads are easily accessible from this area.
A Special Activity Permit is required for the following: Weddings and large events over 20 people, large items brought into the park, event rentals, vendors, food trucks, etc. Please contact the park in advance at (360) 387-1550 to obtain a permit.
